# TcCO2 To PaCO2 Inference App

App URL: https://reblocke.github.io/tcco2-accuracy/
Repository: https://github.com/reblocke/tcco2-accuracy

Purpose:
Static research app for estimating a PaCO2 posterior distribution from an observed transcutaneous CO2 (TcCO2) value using the repository Python model in Pyodide.

Not clinical software:
This is research software only. It is not intended for diagnosis, treatment, or clinical decision-making.

Statistical status:
- Agreement method revision: agreement_natural_log_tau2_direct_v1.
- Browser outputs are provisional pending independent biostatistical review.
- PaCO2-dependent manuscript and downstream outputs remain frozen at the legacy agreement-method revision.

Inputs:
- TcCO2 value in mmHg.
- Hypercapnia threshold in mmHg, default 45.
- Clinical setting selector: all, ambulatory/PFT, ED/inpatient, ICU.
- Optional custom study table upload as CSV/XLSX.
- Optional custom binned PaCO2 prior upload as CSV/XLSX.
- Prior-weighted mode requires that upload; the default likelihood-only mode does not use a prior.

Outputs:
- PaCO2 median and prediction interval.
- Posterior probability that PaCO2 is at or above the selected threshold.
- TcCO2 threshold classification.
- Posterior distribution plot.

Privacy and runtime:
- No backend.
- No telemetry.
- No persistence.
- No patient-value URLs.
- User-entered values and uploads stay in the browser.
- JavaScript handles UI and plotting; Python remains the numerical source of truth.
- Canonical and uploaded-study parameter calculations must report the current method revision and provisional status; stale or mixed canonical parameters fail closed.
- Grouped parameter inputs fail closed when the requested mapped group is absent; successful result metadata records requested_group and parameter_group_used.

Default assets:
- web/assets/data/conway_studies.csv is staged from Data/conway_studies.csv.
- web/assets/data/bootstrap_params.csv is staged from artifacts/bootstrap_params.csv.
- No PaCO2 prior is staged or fetched. Normalized restricted-derived weights may reconstruct the
  source distribution even without count columns, so prior weighting is upload-only and client-side.
- Repository canonical promotion guards that bootstrap artifact against noncanonical study inputs,
  seeds, draw counts, or modes; custom rebuilds cannot replace deployed parameters.
- web/assets/py/ is staged from src/tcco2_accuracy by make stage-web.
- The in-memory draw-aligned downstream workflow is intentionally absent from the Pages Python
  staging allowlist and is not callable from this app.

Default behavior:
- Inference mode is likelihood-only.
- Selecting prior-weighted mode without an uploaded binned prior fails closed and clears stale results.
- Uploaded prior data stay in the browser; the app has no backend, telemetry, persistence, or patient-value URLs.

Governance:
- docs/data_release_contract.json in the repository defines the current-tree, Pages, and public-history asset contract.
- PaCO2-dependent manuscript and downstream files remain frozen and are not release-approved.
- Public branch and tag history is rewritten and checked against the release contract; independently retained clones, caches, and historical deployments outside repository-controlled refs may remain.

Citations:
- CHEST 2025 abstract DOI: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.chest.2025.07.3877
- ATS 2025 abstract DOI: https://doi.org/10.1164/ajrccm.2025.211.Abstracts.A2683
- Conway Thorax evidence synthesis DOI: https://doi.org/10.1136/thoraxjnl-2017-211466
